source='''def transform(grid):
    """Restore cells marked 2 from the grid's dihedral symmetries."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n = len(grid)
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            if grid[r][c] != 2:
                continue
            orbit = {
                (r, c), (r, n - 1 - c), (n - 1 - r, c),
                (n - 1 - r, n - 1 - c),
                (c, r), (c, n - 1 - r),
                (n - 1 - c, r), (n - 1 - c, n - 1 - r),
            }
            candidates = [grid[a][b] for a, b in orbit if grid[a][b] != 2]
            if candidates:
                out[r][c] = max(set(candidates), key=candidates.count)
    return out
'''
